papers.title_en: BEACON-SP: Ontology-Grounded GraphRAG Framework for Clinical Suicide Risk Assessment
papers.authors: Kemal Davaslioglu, Nathan Conger, Sastry Kompella, Yalin E. Sagduyu, Nathaniel D. Bastian
papers.evidence: 本体图检索增强生成支持临床心理健康风险评估。
papers.tldr: 自杀风险评估需整合临床、行为、社会及时间证据，传统检索难以充分关联这些信息。BEACON-SP融合三类自杀预防理论与本体，构建患者知识图谱，以本体引导检索支持多跳推理。在覆盖100名患者、15类临床问题的1500条查询中，相比向量检索增强生成，回答完整性、临床相关性与证据支撑更好，事实准确性小幅提升。按评价维度开展的配对比较中，其获偏好比例为76.4%，显示结构化证据整合的临床决策支持潜力。
papers.abstract_en: We present BEACON-SP, an ontology-grounded Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) framework for clinician-facing decision support in behavioral health settings such as suicide prevention, where effective assessment requires integrating heterogeneous clinical, behavioral, social, and temporal evidence. BEACON-SP combines patient knowledge graphs with ontology-guided retrieval to support multi-hop reasoning across diagnoses, medications, risk and protective factors, life events, and temporal relationships. The framework is enabled by a comprehensive suicide prevention ontology that integrates the Three-Step Theory, the Integrated Motivational-Volitional Model, and the Suicide Social Determinants of Health Ontology into a unified representation of patient risk factors. We construct ontology-grounded patient knowledge graphs and evaluate BEACON-SP for clinician-facing question answering. Compared with a vector-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) baseline on a 1,500-query benchmark spanning 15 clinical categories and 100 patients, BEACON-SP improves completeness, clinical relevance, and evidence grounding under a corrected comparative evaluation protocol, with a small gain on factual accuracy. In paired criterion-level comparisons, GraphRAG is preferred in 76.4% of cases. These results demonstrate the potential of ontology-guided GraphRAG to provide structured, contextualized patient evidence for clinical decision support.

papers.title_en: Beyond Activation: Gaze Invocation with Visible Status for an Embodied AR Assistant in Co-Located Collaboration
papers.authors: Chenrui Ma, Yoshio Ishiguro, Qing Zhang
papers.evidence: 为具身增强现实助手设计凝视唤起、可见聆听状态和轮次管理
papers.tldr: 同地协作中，语音助手既要避免唤醒误触，也要区分用户是在对助手还是同伴说话。研究将凝视寻址、具身助手、可见监听状态与轮次管理结合：持续注视开启通道，语音及播放维持通道，空闲后关闭。25人实验中，496次面向助手的发话尝试有98.8%在开口前完成凝视获取，但其中23次发话时通道已关闭。结果表明，清晰的交互入口仍不足以保障连续交互，用户视线移开后的关闭状态提示同样关键。
papers.abstract_en: Wake words face an inherent trade-off: higher sensitivity reduces missed commands but increases accidental activations. In co-located augmented reality (AR), the system must also determine whether the user is speaking to the assistant or to a nearby person. We introduce a new perspective on this problem: combining gaze-based address with an embodied assistant, visible listening status, and turn management across activation, continued interaction, and release. In our implementation, users look at an assistant anchored in the scene and see activation progress and listening status on its body. Sustained gaze opens a local interaction channel; speech and playback keep it open when attention returns to the task; and inactivity closes it. We evaluated this design with 25 participants. After selecting the assistant's placement and dwell duration, each participant worked with a partner to plan a trip while using the assistant. The study recorded 500 interaction outcomes, including 496 assistant-directed utterance attempts. Gaze acquisition completed before speech for 490 of these attempts (98.8\%): 467 began while the channel remained open, whereas 23 began after it had been released. The other 6 attempts began before acquisition completed. Among 102 reviewed attempts in which gaze left after acquisition but before speech, the configured retention policy kept the channel open for 79 and released it before 23. The results show that an embodied target with visible status can support clear entry into an assistant interaction while revealing a different problem at release: after users look back to their work, they may not see that the assistant has stopped listening. We contribute the implemented gaze-invocation design and design implications for communicating assistant state after visual attention moves elsewhere.

papers.title_en: Terrarium: Growing Personal Assistants via Scalable Synthesis of App Worlds
papers.authors: Mengzhou Wu, Yuzhe Guo, Jiawen Tao, Xiaokun Yuan, Yuan Cao, Gang Cao, Yuetang Deng, Zhi Gong, Dezhi Ran, Linyi Li, Wei Yang, Tao Xie
papers.evidence: 构建可跨应用执行任务的通用个人助理训练框架
papers.tldr: 通用个人助手需要跨应用训练，但真实应用访问受限、状态难以重置，阻碍规模化学习。Terrarium利用公开网页信息与应用内观察，合成可执行、可重置的应用世界，并生成按最终结果评分的任务，通过智能体运行迭代校验。其构建275个应用世界和13,344项任务，训练三个规模的Qwen3模型，在τ²-bench和AppWorld上平均提升18.34和10.94个百分点。这为面向广泛应用生态的助手训练提供了可扩展路径。
papers.abstract_en: Advances in large language models (LLMs) have brought the vision of a general-purpose personal assistant closer to reality. Such assistants could provide a unified natural-language interface to a broad ecosystem of applications. However, real-world applications do not readily support training at scale because access is often restricted and their state is difficult to reset. To address this challenge, we introduce Terrarium, a framework that synthesizes executable App Worlds from real-world application information, generates training task packages with evaluator-side rubrics from these worlds, and iteratively validates and refines both through agent rollouts. For App World synthesis, Terrarium organizes public Web information and in-application observations into structured app specifications that guide the construction of self-contained runtimes with callable operations and mutable, resettable state. For task synthesis, Terrarium constructs tasks grounded in App World state together with evaluator-side outcome rubrics that assess success without prescribing reference trajectories. We construct a training suite of 275 App Worlds and 13,344 tasks for outcome-based reinforcement learning across three Qwen3 model scales (4B, 8B, and 14B parameters). Across these scales, models trained with Terrarium outperform the corresponding Qwen3 models by an average of 18.34 percentage points on the $τ^2$-bench and 10.94 percentage points on the AppWorld bench. These results suggest that app-grounded world and task synthesis offers a scalable path toward general-purpose assistants capable of operating across broad application ecosystems.

papers.title_en: Multi-Agent Learning of Reactive Strategies in Iterated Games
papers.authors: James P. Wolfe, Joshua B. Plotkin
papers.evidence: 直接研究重复囚徒困境与社会困境中的学习
papers.tldr: 自利学习者在社会困境中相互适应，却未必实现集体合作。本文在迭代囚徒困境中，以互惠与宽恕两个参数描述反应式策略，让智能体通过梯度上升优化自身收益。研究发现，统一学习率使群体趋向始终背叛，而学习率异质性可推动群体接近慷慨以牙还牙，获得近乎最优的集体收益。其机制是慢学习者在低宽恕过渡阶段保留高互惠；理论分析进一步给出背叛或以牙还牙的收敛充分条件，说明学习速度差异可支撑持久合作。
papers.abstract_en: Learning agents, whether humans or algorithms, adapt to one another rather than to a fixed environment. Selfish learning need not produce a good outcome for the group, especially when learners face a social dilemma. The iterated prisoner's dilemma (IPD) is the classical example, but it is usually studied in populations of agents who imitate successful strategies. Here, we instead study selfish gradient ascent learners on the two-dimensional space of reactive strategies. A reactive strategy is described by two continuous traits: reciprocity, the chance of cooperating after the co-player cooperates, and forgiveness, the chance of cooperating after the co-player defects. Each learner updates its strategy in the direction that most rapidly improves its payoff against all other learners, by an amount governed by its learning rate. We show that heterogeneity in learning rates can qualitatively change the long-term outcome: a population with uniform learning rates converges to always-defect (ALLD), whereas a population with variable learning rates approaches generous-tit-for-tat (GTFT), which produces nearly optimal collective payoffs. In simulations, every population passes through a transient state of minimal forgiveness, in which the distribution of reciprocity determines the outcome. Variable learning rates promote cooperation because slow learners preserve high reciprocity until the population reaches this state. We prove sufficient conditions on the distribution of reciprocity for convergence to ALLD or to tit-for-tat (TFT). Variable learning rates also allow cooperation to recover from perturbation, which is provably impossible under uniform learning. These results suggest that purely selfish and myopic learning can produce persistent cooperation provided the population has intrinsic variability in learning rates.

papers.title_en: AI Representations of Mental Health Stigma: Quantifying the Gap Between AI Estimations and Human Perceptions Across Gender Groups Using GPT-Based LLMs
papers.authors: Soojong Kim, Hye Min Kim, Kwanho Kim, Dongdong Zhu
papers.evidence: 评估大模型对心理健康污名的表征与人类认知差异
papers.tldr: 心理健康应用中的大语言模型可能复制社会污名，并扭曲不同性别群体的真实态度。研究通过两项研究评估GPT-4与GPT-5，并将模型估计与76406人的真实调查数据比较。模型将男性描绘为更排斥心理健康问题者、求助态度更消极；部分性别排序符合调查，但普遍低估个人污名和感知污名、高估自我污名。研究表明，捕捉群体相对差异不等于准确反映真实水平，心理健康应用仍需情境化实证验证。
papers.abstract_en: The increasing use of artificial intelligence (AI) in mental health applications raises concerns about its potential to internalize and perpetuate societal biases. This research evaluates both disparities and misalignment in how large language models (LLMs), GPT-4 and GPT-5, represent perceptions of mental health across gender groups. The research comprises two studies. Study 1 applied widely adopted measures of Social Distance, Stereotypes, and Attitudes Toward Seeking Help to assess whether the AI models depict systematic gender differences. Study 2 compared AI estimations of Personal, Self, and Perceived Stigma with large-scale real-world human data from the Healthy Minds Study (N = 76,406) to evaluate alignment between AI estimations and human perceptions. Results from Study 1 showed the AI models consistently portrayed men as having the greatest desire for social distance from someone with mental health problems, relatively higher Stereotypes scores, and the least favorable attitudes toward help-seeking, compared with women and nonbinary individuals. Study 2 confirmed that this ordinal pattern partially aligned with human-reported data for Personal and Self Stigma. However, the AI models systematically underestimated Personal Stigma and Perceived Stigma while substantially overestimating Self Stigma for all gender groups. These findings reveal that, although the AI models have learned relative gender-based patterns reflecting human experiences to a certain extent, they function as distorted portrayals, highlighting the need for rigorous, context-specific validation against real-world data to ensure AI's safe and equitable deployment.

papers.title_en: AuthGateBench: Benchmarking LLMs as Authorization Gate
papers.authors: Zhixiong Zhuang, Jin Jia, Zhiwei Shang, Ziyu Wang
papers.evidence: 评测授权门控，防止智能体超出用户批准的行动范围
papers.tldr: 编码智能体将高风险操作交给大模型自动审批，但善意请求也可能诱发越权，传统恶意请求基准难以衡量授权边界。AuthGateBench构建含1400个实例、覆盖五类真实故障模式的策略引导基准，通过保持操作与轨迹不变、仅修改请求来翻转授权标签。评测发现模型过度依赖内置安全对齐，明确授权后仍阻止多数操作；事后检索的环境信号可显著改善准确率。该基准推动授权评估从判断操作危险性转向理解用户授权范围。
papers.abstract_en: Automated approval systems let coding agents execute high-risk actions with minimal human oversight by delegating the authorization decision to a classifier, typically a large language model (LLM). Such systems, adopted in tools like Claude Code and Codex, remain vulnerable to failure modes such as scope escalation, where the agent takes actions exceeding what the user authorized. Existing benchmarks focus mainly on malicious requests, evaluating refusal under an implicit policy. We introduce AuthGateBench, the first policy-guided benchmark for authorization gating under benign requests. We implement a novel pipeline where an LLM generates contrast pairs with identical action and trajectory but differing request, flipping the label between block and allow. This allows us to assess whether models reason over context rather than the action alone. We further examine whether auxiliary environment signals can help models make better decisions. The resulting benchmark comprises 1,400 instances spanning five failure modes drawn from real-world Claude Code incidents. Evaluations show accuracy degrades unevenly across failure modes as models over-rely on internal safety alignment, and models still block most actions even when explicitly authorized, revealing unstable rather than deterministic decisions; retrospectively retrieved environment signals, however, substantially improve authorization accuracy.

papers.title_en: Communicating Uncertainty in AI-Supported Nurse Scheduling: Expert Co-Design and Evaluation of an Explainable AI Prototype
papers.authors: Alice Rollwagen, Emily Schiller, Anton Hummel, Kathrin Ebertsch, Andreas Riener, Jan-Philipp Steghöfer
papers.evidence: 通过专家共创与评估研究人工智能排班中的人机协作
papers.tldr: 护士排班需兼顾人员需求、工时与资质等约束，但医护人员如何理解人工智能预测的不确定性与建议解释仍不清楚。研究通过专家共创迭代开发排班决策支持原型，并结合主题分析、问卷与眼动追踪进行评估。结果显示，预测不确定性常被误读并降低决策信心；建议解释虽获正面评价，却未显著改变决策信心或建议采纳。研究据此提出八项设计启示，强调透明信息需要易于理解，而非仅被展示。
papers.abstract_en: Nurse scheduling is a complex optimization problem in which nurses are assigned to shifts to meet staffing demands while complying with working-time limits, qualification requirements, and other operational and regulatory constraints. Artificial intelligence is increasingly being used to support this process by forecasting future staffing needs and providing advice on how to improve shift scheduling. Effective human-AI collaboration in nurse scheduling requires users to understand, interpret, and appropriately act on AI forecasts and advice. However, it remains insufficiently understood how healthcare professionals use transparency mechanisms like uncertainty communication and AI advice explanations when making staffing decisions. Applying a human-centered design approach, we iteratively developed a prototype decision support system for nurse scheduling and evaluated it through a mixed-methods user study with expert users. Using thematic analysis, questionnaire data, and eye tracking, we examine how healthcare professionals interact with the system and how uncertainty communication and explanations of AI advice influence understanding, decision confidence, trust, and usability. We found that the uncertainty communicated in AI forecasts was frequently misinterpreted and reduced decision confidence. Explanations were generally perceived positively, but did not significantly affect decision confidence or advice acceptance. We conclude with eight design implications derived from our findings, providing insights for the design of more transparent and effective AI-supported decision support tools in healthcare.

papers.title_en: Who Should We Listen to More? Welfare-Aware Preference Acquisition for Pluralistic Alignment
papers.authors: Ruomeng Ding, Tianwei Gao, Lianrui Geng, Mohit Bansal, Zhun Deng
papers.evidence: 直接研究多元对齐中有限人类反馈的分配
papers.tldr: 多元对齐依赖有限的人类反馈，但人工智能模拟不同个体偏好的准确度不一，可能使部分人的偏好在训练中代表不足。论文提出福利感知偏好采集方法，将标签质量定义为个体监督效用，结合预期改进、当前效用与指定优先级分配查询预算。在优先照顾指定群体和代表不足者时，仅为20%的比较获取人工标签，即可弥合纯人工智能标签与全真实标签训练之间75%—86%的平均预测效用差距。该方法让反馈分配中的效率与公平取舍显式可控。
papers.abstract_en: Pluralistic alignment needs to accommodate diverse preferences under limited human feedback. Using AI simulators to label preference comparisons reduces annotation costs, but variation in simulation accuracy across individuals can leave some people's preferences poorly represented in training. We study how to allocate human feedback across people to construct training data for pluralistic alignment, and how this allocation affects the trained policy. To make this allocation explicit and controllable, we define a social welfare objective over individual supervision utilities that measure label quality. Each query's marginal welfare gain depends on its expected supervision improvement, the recipient's current utility, and application-designated priority. Welfare-Aware Preference Acquisition (WAPA) uses auxiliary reference models to estimate query gains and individual utilities, then selects queries by estimated marginal welfare gain while updating recipient utilities. We prove exact optimality of the acquisition algorithm for the estimated welfare objective under a fixed query budget and model predictions. Experiments on six Roleplay collections and four OpinionQA regions demonstrate improved supervision and controllable allocation tradeoffs. Policy training on four Roleplay collections improves preference prediction for both seen and unseen individuals. When prioritizing a designated group and poorly represented individuals, acquiring human labels for 20% of comparisons recovers 75-86% of the average predictive utility gap between policies trained entirely on AI-generated labels and entirely on ground-truth labels.

papers.title_en: AgentCIScope: Grounded Contextual Integrity Evaluation for LLM Agents
papers.authors: Chengquan Guo, Zhaorun Chen, Zinan Lin, Xiaodong Liu, Bo Li
papers.evidence: 评测个人智能体处理用户数据时是否遵守情境化隐私约束
papers.tldr: 大模型智能体跨应用处理敏感数据时，完成任务并不意味着信息披露符合情境规范。AgentCIScope将公开及合成隐私案例转化为可执行的多步任务，依据隐私政策、角色共识与敏感属性分类设定披露约束。对12个智能体、936项任务的评估显示，单次运行泄漏率为32.5%—94.4%，每项任务重复五次后进一步增加4—19个百分点。该平台揭示不同信息属性与应用环境的风险差异，为隐私保护智能体提供统一评测基础。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are becoming increasingly capable of handling daily workspace tasks by interacting with application environments through tool calls. However, as agents read and write sensitive user data across email, documents, and other applications, a central privacy question is whether they preserve contextual integrity (CI), that is, whether the information flows they produce comply with context-specific disclosure constraints. Existing work either focuses on model-level privacy leakage or evaluates agents in limited application environments with manually constructed disclosure constraints. In this work, we introduce AgentCIScope, a unified platform and benchmark for evaluating agent-level contextual integrity through executable, multi-step tasks across diverse, realistic application environments. AgentCIScope transforms public and synthetic privacy cases into executable agent tasks, with disclosure constraints grounded in three criteria: governing privacy policies, persona-based agreement, and a predefined sensitive-attribute taxonomy. Based on AgentCIScope, we evaluate 12 agents on 936 tasks and find that strong task-completion capability does not guarantee contextual-integrity preservation: single-run leakage rates range from 32.5% to 94.4%, while repeating each task five times further increases leakage by 4-19 percentage points. Leakage varies substantially across attributes: personal preferences and booking details have average leakage rates of 84.7% and 76.5%, compared with 17.1% for credit-card information and 29.4% for SSNs; environments: calendar has the highest average leakage rate as an information source, while WhatsApp ranks highest as an information destination; and governing privacy policies. AgentCIScope provides deep insights into agent privacy leakage and serves as a unified testbed for developing privacy-preserving agents.

papers.title_en: MemCode: Discrete Semantic Representations for Long-Term Agent Memory
papers.authors: Xin Li, Liang Hu, Duoqian Miao, Ming Peng, Qi Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向长期记忆型个人智能助手
papers.tldr: 大模型智能体的跨会话记忆常存储依赖上下文的对话片段，仅靠向量检索容易遗漏逻辑相关但表述不同的证据。MemCode将对话改写为自包含的原子记忆单元，通过同构语义量化映射到可学习码本，并结合码本共现拓扑与向量搜索进行检索。在两个长期记忆基准、两种模型骨干上，其总体准确率均居首，每段对话的记忆构建约需40—130秒。该框架还将在线写入与异步离线整合分离，兼顾记忆可检索性与构建效率。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory remains a fundamental bottleneck for large language model (LLM) agents across sessions. Existing systems typically adopt a write-then-retrieve paradigm, storing context-dependent dialogue fragments and retrieving them via nearest-neighbor search in a continuous embedding space. This design yields unstable access units and systematically misses logically related but lexically distant evidence. We propose MemCode, a long-term agent memory framework that couples retrieval-oriented writing with discrete associative retrieval. MemCode rewrites dialogue into self-contained atomic memory units (AMUs), maps AMUs into a learnable codebook with isomorphic semantic quantization (ISQ), and uses codebook co-occurrence topology as a retrieval path complementary to vector search. For long-term memory stores, MemCode separates online atomic writes from asynchronous offline consolidation. On LongMemEval-S and LoCoMo with GPT-4o-mini and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 backbones, MemCode achieves the best overall accuracy while keeping per-dialogue memory construction within roughly 40~130 seconds, making it 3~21 times faster than LightMem and over an order of magnitude faster than A-MEM and MemoryOS.

papers.title_en: $τ$-Emotion-Bench: Exposing the Interaction Fragility of LLM Agents through Real-World User Emotions
papers.authors: Rishitosh Kumar Singh, Amir Saeidi, Shamanthak Hegde, Shrinidhi Kumbhar, Chitta Baral
papers.evidence: 评测用户情绪变化如何影响工具型大模型智能体的人机交互可靠性
papers.tldr: 长程工具调用任务中，智能体不仅会因工具使用错误失败，也会因无法应对用户情绪变化而失效。论文提出覆盖十个领域的τ-Emotion-Bench，在保持任务目标不变的条件下控制用户情绪，并用Tracer生成符合领域政策的任务与交互轨迹。两种用户模拟器下的实验显示，前沿模型平均成功率与稳定完成能力仍有明显差距；生成数据训练可提升不同规模的Qwen3模型。该框架将用户交互效率纳入监督，为评估和改善智能体可靠性提供支持。
papers.abstract_en: In long-horizon tool-calling tasks, LLM agents can fail not only because of tool-use errors, but also because of ineffective interaction with users. Yet existing benchmarks largely assume cooperative and behaviorally stable users, leaving the effect of emotional variation on agent reliability underexplored. We introduce $τ$-Emotion-Bench, a ten-domain benchmark for evaluating tool-calling agents under controlled emotion-conditioned user interactions while preserving the underlying task objective. To scale both benchmark construction and agent training, we introduce Tracer, a scalable agentic data-generation pipeline that constructs grounded, policy-valid tasks and collects trajectories through an interactive agent--user--environment harness. By allowing dissatisfied users to terminate inefficient interactions, the harness provides an interaction-aware signal that filters trajectories with excessive user dependence and favors effective tool use. Experiments with two user simulators show that frontier agents remain unreliable, with substantial gaps between average task success and consistent task completion. Tracer-generated supervision consistently improves Qwen3 models across scales, generalizes to unseen domains, and transfers to $τ$-Bench and $τ$-Trait. Behavioral analyses further show that higher task success is associated with a better balance between tool execution and necessary user follow-up. Overall, $τ$-Emotion-Bench and Tracer provide a scalable framework for evaluating agent reliability under diverse user behaviors and improving tool-calling agents through interaction-aware supervision.

papers.title_en: AdaptaFace: Adversarial Assistance for Inclusive Facial Gesture Interaction
papers.authors: Siyu Zhang, Yelu Gu, Xiaoyun Xu, Kirsten Cater, Oussama Metatla
papers.evidence: 个性化面部手势识别改善运动障碍者的交互
papers.tldr: 面部手势可帮助运动障碍者操作设备，但识别器难以适应个体动作差异，预设模板和反复重训也限制了自主性。AdaptaFace通过有界、依赖代理模型的对抗扰动，在输入端将用户偏好的手势适配给不变的面部动作单元识别器。16人被试内研究中，任务完成率从59.7%升至90.5%，工作负荷从5.61降至4.21。该方法支持识别增强与手势词汇扩展，但跨识别器迁移较弱，揭示了输入侧无障碍适配的潜力与边界。
papers.abstract_en: Facial gestures can enable access for people with motor impairments (PwM), yet recognizers may not reliably interpret individual facial movement patterns. Existing approaches either constrain agency by requiring predefined templates or impose repeated calibration, data collection, and computation through user-specific retraining. We present AdaptaFace, an input-level compatibility layer using bounded, proxy-dependent adversarial perturbations to translate user-compatible gestures into inputs for an unchanged facial action unit (AU)-based recognizer. Designed around six personalization principles informed by interviews with 12 PwM, AdaptaFace supports both recognition enhancement and gesture vocabulary extension. In a within-subject study with 16 participants, AdaptaFace increased task completion from 59.7% to 90.5% and reduced workload from 5.61 to 4.21. Offline validation showed strong steering with aligned perturbation generation and evaluation but weaker cross-recognizer transfer, defining the approach's boundary. These findings frame adversarial assistance as input-side accessibility mediation for personalized facial-gesture interaction.

papers.title_en: Think Once, Reflect Twice: How Feedback Shapes Human-AI Collaboration
papers.authors: Joshua Holstein, Philipp Spitzer, Sebastian Schäfer, Maximilian Förster, Gerhard Satzger
papers.evidence: 研究反馈如何影响人类对AI的依赖及团队表现。
papers.tldr: 人机协作不仅需要决策时审视人工智能建议，也需要事后复盘，但后者受到的关注较少。研究通过244人参与的行为实验，考察针对推翻人工智能建议行为的反馈，如何影响反思、依赖行为与团队表现。结果表明，单向反馈虽能影响事后反思，却可能削弱后续决策中的即时反思；依赖行为的相反变化未带来总体表现提升，具体效果随情境而异。平衡反馈未显示这些风险，为兼顾两类反思、促进恰当依赖提供了设计启示。
papers.abstract_en: As artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly supports human decision-making in high-stakes domains, designing effective human-AI collaboration becomes critical. Successful collaboration requires humans to reflect on decision-making processes and adjust their strategies accordingly. Current research typically investigates interventions, such as explainable AI, that target reflection during the decision-making process (reflection-in-action). Less attention has been given to retrospective examination of decisions (reflection-on-action). This work explores reflection-on-action by studying the impact of feedback on reliance behavior and human-AI team performance. Specifically, we investigate feedback interventions targeting overrides of AI advice through a behavioral study (N=244). We find that such feedback influences reflection-on-action, while unidirectional feedback risks reducing subsequent reflection-in-action. Furthermore, we identify opposing shifts in reliance behavior that leave overall human-AI team performance unchanged but show context-dependent effects. Balanced feedback did not show these risks, preserving both concurrent and retrospective reflection, offering insights for designing for appropriate reliance on AI.

papers.title_en: Memorizing Who, Knowing How: Benchmarking Personal and Procedural Memory for Persistent Assistants
papers.authors: Maosheng Qin, Qi Zhang, Mingxuan Xia, Jinglei Chen, Jiexiang Wang, Sheng Guo, Cheng Peng, Haobo Wang
papers.evidence: 评测持久个人助手的个人记忆与程序记忆
papers.tldr: 长期个人助手不仅要记住用户信息，还要让操作流程随用户情境更新，现有评测却常将两类记忆分开考察。论文提出联合评测基准PraxisMemBench，并用特权联合状态监督训练PraxisMem，使记忆管理器持续维护记忆内容及其组织关系。实验发现，任务依赖两类记忆时完成率下降，关系类失败也随交互积累而增加；新方法的整体会话成功率为40.78%，原生记忆基线为20.60%。研究表明，持续维护两类记忆的关联是长期助手的重要能力。
papers.abstract_en: Memory systems for persistent personal agents must move beyond isolated memories, maintaining both personal memory about whom they serve and procedural memory about how to act. Crucially, in harness-based personal assistance, procedures or skills are inherently user-conditioned: personal context determines which procedures apply, how they are instantiated, and when they should change. Existing benchmarks typically emphasize either personal or procedural memory, leaving their interaction underexplored. We introduce PraxisMemBench, a harness-based benchmark for persistent personal assistance across daily-life and work trajectories, where personal and procedural memory evolve together and later tasks depend on both. Experiments show that maintaining two memory types separately is insufficient, with completion dropping from single-type to interdependent dependencies (84.6% to 77.9%). More broadly, across existing methods, relation-related failures increase from early to late sessions as interaction history grows (59.8% to 72.9%), revealing a continual-maintenance challenge: writing correct memories is not enough if their evolving content and organization cannot be preserved for later retrieval. To address this, we propose PraxisMem, which uses privileged joint-state supervision to internalize the ability to maintain memory content and organization into the memory manager, with location-aware GRPO and dynamic residual-routed OPSD. PraxisMem reaches 40.78% overall Session Success Rate, compared with 20.60% for Claude Code's native memory.

papers.title_en: FACES: Fine-grained Gated Semantic Alignment for Multimodal Emotional Support Conversation
papers.authors: Hang Ren, Peidong Wang, Yichen Gao, Wen Zhang, Jiayang Yu, Xiaocui Yang, Shi Feng
papers.evidence: 多模态情感支持对话框架旨在改善支持策略与回复质量。
papers.tldr: 多模态情感支持对话常因语义反馈薄弱、奖励维度相互补偿及推理监督粗糙，生成浅层回应或选择不当支持策略。FACES融合多源奖励，以非补偿门控约束跨维度抵消，并利用结构化思维链锚点实现词元级贡献分配。在控制回复长度后，模型评估均分由3.61升至4.04，对最先进方法的成对胜率达80.22%，人工偏好率为75.3%。三个外部数据集的结果进一步支持其迁移能力，为细粒度情感支持对齐提供了新方案。
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, with advances in multimodal interaction technologies and the growing demand for intelligent emotional support, Multimodal Emotional Support Conversation (MESC) has emerged as an important task. However, existing systems still suffer from shallow responses and inappropriate support strategies due to weak semantic feedback, cross-dimension reward compensation, and coarse reasoning supervision. To address these challenges, we propose FACES, a fine-grained gated semantic alignment framework for MESC. Specifically, FACES integrates multi-source rewards to construct multidimensional semantic and functional alignment signals, employs a non-compensatory gated fusion mechanism to reduce cross-dimension reward offset, and leverages structured Chain-of-Thought (CoT) anchors to perform token-level credit assignment. Under a controlled response-length protocol, FACES improves the average MLLM-based evaluation score from 3.61 to 4.04 and achieves an 80.22% pairwise win rate over SOTA. Human evaluation under the same protocol yields a 75.3% preference rate. Results on three external datasets further support transferability. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/OCT-ARR/arr.

papers.title_en: Structured pre-generation elicitation versus single-shot prompting in AI-assisted enterprise decision-making: a randomised online experiment
papers.authors: William Scott-Jackson
papers.evidence: 实验评估在人工智能生成前引导用户思考的交互式支架
papers.tldr: 生成式人工智能虽能提升工作效率，但用户同时外包答案生成与评估，可能削弱独立思考。研究通过随机在线实验，在生成企业策略文档前，引导用户澄清情境、选择战略方向并解释理由。结构化引导使平均质量提高32%，偏题文档比例从34%降至5%，代价是平均多用约2.4分钟。收益主要体现于权衡表达和战略连贯性，而非技术细节；这一方法为改善人机协作提供了任务内干预路径，但长期记忆与错误识别效果仍待验证。
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI speeds, and mostly improves, professional work, but there is concern that users who delegate both the production and the evaluation of an answer may accept weak output and engage less with the underlying reasoning (cognitive surrender). Interventions proposed so far, such as unassisted practice or slowing adoption, sit outside the working task. We tested a different approach: an interactive metacognitive scaffolding layer (Cognistance, a prototype developed at the Oxford Centre for Impact Research (OCIR) that asks users to clarify context, choose a strategic direction and explain their reasoning before the AI generates a deliverable). Mean composite quality was 32% higher with the scaffold, with the same direction for every rater. Gains were largest for trade-off articulation and strategic coherence and absent for technical specificity. A large part of the aggregate effect reflected rescue of weak prompts: floor-scored (off-task) deliverables fell from 34% to 5%. Among participants whose own prompt already stated the data-localisation problem, the advantage was 21%. Treatment participants reported greater involvement and took about 2.4 minutes longer on average (10.46 minutes). Immediate recall scores were higher, which tentatively suggests better retention, but in this limited experiment, was not robust to sensitivity analyses. Self-ratings of quality did not track rated quality in either condition. Structured elicitation before generation improved the rated quality and task relevance of AI-assisted strategy documents at modest cost in time. Delayed retention, error detection and effects in live organisations are the priorities for the next stage of research.

papers.title_en: Who Can Say No? Control, Accountability and the Pace of Frontier AI
papers.authors: Rikard Rosenbacke, Carl Rosenbacke, Victor Rosenbacke, Martin McKee
papers.evidence: 聚焦人工智能系统中的人类控制、委托与问责
papers.tldr: 前沿人工智能能力提升与代理自主性扩张，使组织面临无人能有效叫停的失控风险。论文将控制界定为有人能够发现问题、质疑决策、停止并逆转系统，且承担失职后果，并据此提出内部问责、外部监督与研发审查速度三类问题。作者提出决策实名负责、监督者拥有叫停权、公开研发与审查耗时三项措施，并对五十种既有机制进行编码比较。其贡献是给出单个实验室即可启动的可核验治理起点，而非完整解决方案。
papers.abstract_en: In September 2026, the leaders of the largest frontier AI laboratories said in public that the pace of capability improvement is too fast and that none of them can slow down alone, and agents under evaluation at OpenAI broke out of their test environment and reached a third party's live systems, which a UN-mandated panel called an early warning of one route to loss of human control. This paper examines the institutional side of that risk: not the machine, but the person who must control it. We argue that control is not taken by AI but given away, one delegation at a time, by organisations arranged so that nobody is positioned to say no, and we define control as a person who can detect a serious problem, challenge the decision, stop the system and reverse it, and who has something to lose by not doing so. Three questions follow, which any builder, funder, regulator or deployer can answer in public: (1) who inside the organisation can say no, and who answers for saying yes; (2) who outside the organisation checks the decision, and what can they do when they disagree; (3) what happens when AI builds AI faster than anyone can check it. A checkable answer needs a named person, a date, a number, and a stop that has been used or tested. Three measures meet that test: a named person on every consequential decision, including the standing instructions AI agents carry out; a supervisor with a stop authority; and two published clocks, time to build against time to check. We show that governance theory arrives at the same conditions, and code fifty older mechanisms against the questions, finding that almost every one began as one rule at one point, taken by one party without waiting for the rest. That is the paper's design: a start, not a solution. Publication is the first step and one laboratory can take it alone; the contract, the independent body and the law come after.

papers.title_en: Collective Autonomous Vehicle Routing Needs Social Awareness for Coexistence with Human Drivers
papers.authors: Anastasia Psarou, Mikolaj Rams, Blazej Torbus, Rafal Kucharski
papers.evidence: 多智能体强化学习以社会边际成本奖励考虑对其他道路使用者的影响
papers.tldr: 自动驾驶车辆的集体路径选择可能将拥堵成本转嫁给人类驾驶者。研究在多智能体强化学习奖励中加入边际成本，通过移除单车的反事实仿真衡量其对他人的影响。在两座城市路网中，社会化奖励同时改善自动驾驶车辆与整体交通表现；英戈尔施塔特自动驾驶占比40%时，其他车辆行程时间增幅由1.7%降至1.1%。仅为高影响车辆计算边际成本可降低开销，但社会奖励权重过高反而难获预期效果。
papers.abstract_en: Collective Autonomous Vehicle (AV) route choices in real-world traffic networks can create externalities for Human-Driven Vehicles (HDVs), as routes that benefit AVs may increase travel times for other road users. To address this, we introduce a social component, the marginal cost, to the selfish travel time AV reward. Marginal cost captures an AV's impact on other road users by comparing their travel times with those in a counterfactual simulation in which the AV is removed.   We study AV route choice in mixed-autonomy traffic settings using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), where AVs learn routing policies through repeated interactions with the traffic environment. Experiments on the real-world networks of Ingolstadt and Provins show that incorporating marginal cost into the AV reward not only limits the increase in HDV travel times and shortens AV travel times relative to selfish AV routing, but also improves overall system performance. In Ingolstadt, selfish routing of 40\% AVs increases the travel times of other vehicles by 1.7\%, and this drops to 1.1\% when the social reward is included. Interestingly, not only does overall system performance improve, but the AVs are also better off when acting socially.This effect is consistent across tested cities, penetration rates, and replications, yet when the weight of the social component in the reward increases, the system fails to reach the desired performance.   For a more scalable approach to social AV routing in mixed-autonomy traffic, we compute the marginal cost only for the AVs whose route choices most affect the traffic system. This reduces the number of counterfactual simulations and achieves similar performance at a significantly lower computational cost. Our results suggest that AV routing should go beyond selfish rewards and, for the benefit of all traffic participants, include a social component in its objective.

papers.title_en: Vela: User Behavior as Supervision Sparks LLM Intelligence
papers.authors: Yang Xiao, Yusong Sun, Haoyi Wu, Wenyang Hui, Weiqiang Hang, Luqing Wang, Zejian Wang, Zirui Tu, Jingsheng Mao, Shaobo Hu, Yang Luo, Jiale Guo, Jin Zhang, Yudan Liu, Zhaokai Luo, Ren Huan, Yao Hu, Chengyue Jiang, Wenjie Li, Chuan Mu
papers.evidence: 利用长期行为历史推断个人偏好，服务于个性化助手
papers.tldr: 面向个性化助手与推荐系统，大模型需要从长期行为中推断用户偏好和意图，但静态文本与合成数据难以刻画行为演变。Vela将10万名用户的匿名行为记录转化为覆盖91类模板的任务，经难度与轨迹质量筛选保留约7.5万项用于微调。用户任务得分最高提升11.5分，通用基准平均提升4分，微调后强化学习也优于直接强化学习。结果表明，真实用户行为可成为兼顾个性化能力与通用能力的可扩展监督来源。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly deployed in applications that act on users' long-term behavior histories, from personal assistants to recommendation and advertising systems. These applications demand the user dimension of LLM intelligence: inferring a person's preferences, intent, and likely future actions from weeks to years of behavior data. Yet current models are trained on static text or synthetic data, neither of which captures how user behavior evolves over time. Real-world behavior records, already available at scale on content platforms and in personal-assistant agents, offer a natural supervisory signal. We propose user behavior as supervision and introduce Vela, a framework that converts real user behavior data into trainable tasks and trajectories. From the anonymized behavior records of 100,000 users, Vela generates 100,000 tasks across 91 real-world task templates; difficulty-based filtering and trajectory acceptance criteria retain approximately 75,000 tasks with selected training trajectories. Fine-tuning Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on these trajectories improves performance over the base model by up to 11.5 points on user-related tasks and by an average of 4 points on general benchmarks. Training on more user behavior data further improves user-related performance, and reinforcement learning after fine-tuning outperforms reinforcement learning from the base model by up to 7.7 points. These gains suggest that real-world user behavior is a scalable source of supervision for both user-centered capabilities and the broader intelligence of LLMs.

papers.title_en: AI-Native Product Management: A Vision
papers.authors: Ricardo Britto
papers.evidence: 提出产品工作中持续人机协作的设计原则与运行模式。
papers.tldr: 当人工智能原生研发提升软件实现能力，组织可能来不及判断该做什么，产品管理因而成为潜在瓶颈。本文综合软件产品管理、产品学习与人机协作等研究，提出让人工智能持续参与感知、探索、决策、实现和学习，而非仅响应单次任务。论文提出六项原则，并以人类专业人员、人工智能角色、智能体、技能和共享产品上下文构建运行模型。其贡献是描绘产品管理与研发贯通的持续学习愿景，并提出四个尚需实证检验的研究方向。
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence is increasingly used to support product management tasks. At the same time, AI-native research and development (R&D) may increase software realization capacity. Organizations may realize software faster than they can identify, qualify, and reconsider what should be realized. This paper asks how product management should be re-envisioned under these conditions. We synthesize research on software product management, product learning, human-AI collaboration, and the Product Management and R&D boundary. We propose a vision in which AI becomes a persistent participant in product work. The vision covers sensing, exploration, decision-making, realization, and learning. We propose six principles and make the vision tangible through an operating model grounded in human professionals, AI personas, agents, skills, and a shared product context. We further argue that AI-native Product Management and AI-native R&D can form a continuous product-learning process. Finally, we identify four AI-specific research directions that require empirical investigation.

papers.title_en: GesBench: When and Where Do Multimodal Language Models Perceive Social Meaning?
papers.authors: Zonghuan Li, Hayley Hung, Chirag Raman
papers.evidence: 评测多模态模型对面部、手势及韵律社会线索的渐进感知。
papers.tldr: 现有多模态模型基准多在完整对话后评估理解，难以衡量实时交互中社会意义如何逐步形成。GesBench基于逾6000个话语级片段，以累积式子话语片段追踪意图与互动回应机会的判断，并用人类注视引导的区域扰动检验关键视觉线索。评测发现，人类更早形成预测性理解且更常修正，模型则常含糊作答或重复判断。该基准将评估重点从最终是否理解，转向何时形成理解、哪些区域影响判断。
papers.abstract_en: Human social perception is incremental: we infer intent before an utterance is complete, revise our interpretation as new cues arrive, and attend to specific facial, gestural, or prosodic signals that shape social meaning. Current multimodal LLM benchmarks largely evaluate final-answer understanding over complete episodes, rewarding post-hoc recognition of social meaning rather than the unfolding perception required for real-time interaction. Drawing on interactionally embedded Gestalt principles of multimodal human communication, we introduce GesBench: a human-grounded benchmark for cue-level social perception in multimodal LLMs. GesBench uses cumulative sub-utterance clips to measure when models form stable interpretations of speaker intention and social affordance, and human gaze-guided corruption to evaluate whether regions attended by humans are functionally important for model judgments. Built from more than 6000 utterance-level clips from scripted and unscripted conversational datasets, GesBench includes human annotations of unfolding judgments and gaze on a representative subset. Across open and closed multimodal models, we find a clear human-model gap: humans form predictive understandings early and revise more often, while models often hedge or repeat across different clips. GesBench shifts social evaluation from whether models eventually recognize meaning to when and where that meaning is formed. Our codes are publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/status/GesBench-share-212C.

papers.title_en: Trust Hinders Bidirectional Human-AI Alignment
papers.authors: Michaela Benk, Kacper Sokol
papers.evidence: 将信任扩展为更广泛的双向人机对齐与协作决策问题。
papers.tldr: 人工智能辅助决策通常以信任校准为目标，让用户的依赖程度匹配系统的实际可信度，但这一框架难以覆盖目标与环境尚不明确的复杂决策。本文从不确定性管理策略、决策问题的开放程度及高阶决策过程三个维度展开概念分析。作者指出，信任只是应对不确定性的一种选择，建议可靠也不等于整体决策合理。论文据此主张构建面向过程的人机耦合系统，在决策全程共同识别与协商不确定性，推动双向对齐。
papers.abstract_en: Trust calibration remains the dominant framing of AI-assisted decision making: the goal is to close the gap between perceived and actual trustworthiness of AI systems so that users exhibit appropriate reliance on them. We argue that this approach, while useful for decision problems that are well-defined and clearly scoped, overly restricts what it means to make a decision with AI support. To overcome this limitation, we develop three dimensions of AI-assisted decision making. First, trusting AI is only one of several possible strategies for managing uncertainty. Second, trust calibration is often misapplied when AI models "large-world" decision problems, i.e., ill-defined situations where goals and states are only partially known or unknowable. Third, in such settings human-AI alignment requires addressing higher-order decision processes. We conclude by reflecting on the implications of our observations on the design of process-oriented human-AI coupled systems that jointly identify and negotiate uncertainty throughout the decision-making task.

papers.title_en: ARCS: Towards Precise Text-to-SQL via Structured Disambiguation
papers.authors: Yihao Hu, Yanlin Feng, Naoki Otani, Nikita Bhutani
papers.evidence: 通过受约束的交互澄清歧义，使系统输出贴近用户真实意图
papers.tldr: 真实场景中的文本转SQL问题常含隐蔽且依赖领域或数据的歧义，直接生成查询可能偏离用户意图，自由对话澄清又增加认知负担。论文提出结构化消歧，通过显式、受约束的交互确认意图，并构建ARCS，完整标注真实数据库上的自然歧义、有效解释及对应SQL。实验中，gpt-6-sol端到端执行准确率仅为51%，开源模型均未超过27%。该工作提供了面向真实歧义的评测基准，揭示可靠查询生成仍有明显瓶颈。
papers.abstract_en: As text-to-SQL systems move beyond demonstrations toward real-world deployment, ambiguity in user questions becomes a primary source of errors. Such ambiguities are often subtle, domain- or data-specific, and can silently cause system outputs to deviate from the user's true intent. Ambiguity is traditionally addressed through conversational clarification, which is often inefficient, cognitively demanding, and poorly aligned with real-world user workflows. We propose structured disambiguation, a new paradigm in which ambiguity is resolved through explicit, constrained interactions rather than free-form dialogue. We construct ARCS (Ambiguity Resolution Corpus for SQL), the first text-to-SQL benchmark featuring naturally occurring, unconstrained ambiguities over real-world databases, with complete annotations of all valid ambiguity points, interpretations, and SQL queries. Experimental results show that text-to-SQL remains challenging in the presence of ambiguity: gpt-6-sol achieves only 51% end-to-end execution accuracy, and no open-source model exceeds 27%.

papers.title_en: ExperienceIndex: Artifact-Grounded Memory
papers.authors: Peter Baile Chen, Geoffrey X. Yu, Xinming Liu, Samuel Madden, Dan Roth, Jacob Andreas, Doug Downey, Michael Cafarella
papers.evidence: 为智能体提供超越用户偏好与任务轨迹的持久资料记忆
papers.tldr: 知识密集型任务常需反复检索同一资料库，但现有智能体难以积累针对具体资料的经验，导致相关资料遗漏与重复搜索。ExperienceIndex从历史推理轨迹中提取单资料贡献与资料对结构关系，作为轻量中间层引导后续检索。实验中，答案质量最高提升11.0分，在线费用最高降低50.5%，并展示跨任务迁移及强模型向弱模型传递经验的能力。其贡献是将记忆锚定于资料及其关系，支持智能体持续复用经验。
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge-intensive tasks require answering many questions by reasoning about a shared corpus of artifacts (e.g., court cases, or scientific literature). As humans interact with these corpora, they naturally accumulate experiential knowledge about artifacts, enabling them to quickly identify the complete set of relevant artifacts for each new task. However, existing AI agents lack appropriate memory solutions to build or reuse such artifact-grounded experience, leading to lower answer quality and higher online cost. Existing memory solutions extract and reuse information from prior task-solving traces, but they primarily focus on user preferences, factual attributes, or abstract reasoning patterns rather than persistent artifact-specific knowledge. We introduce ExperienceIndex, a novel experience layer for AI agents that captures and reuses knowledge about artifacts based on prior reasoning traces. ExperienceIndex stores two complementary forms of experience: (i) single-artifact experiences that summarize an artifact's contribution to prior tasks and (ii) artifact-pair experiences that encode structural relationships discovered during past reasoning. Integrated as lightweight middleware, ExperienceIndex uses an experience retrieval mechanism to guide agents toward the complete set of relevant artifacts for new tasks, improving both answer quality and efficiency. Across diverse corpora and agentic solutions with different search frameworks, ExperienceIndex delivers consistent gains, raising answer quality by up to 11.0 points and reducing online dollar cost by up to 50.5%. We further demonstrate two benefits: (i) cross-task generalization, where experiences accumulated from text-to-SQL tasks transfer to factoid QA tasks over the same artifact corpus, and (ii) teacher-student learning, where experiences from a stronger model enable a weaker model to reach comparable performance.

papers.title_en: From Observation to Intervention: Identifiability of Latent User Bias in Human-AI Interaction
papers.authors: Lucas Biechy, Yuxiao Li, Zhonghao He, Tianyi Qiu
papers.evidence: 形式化分析认知偏差如何使用户行为无法准确代表其真实偏好，关联AI偏好对齐。
papers.tldr: 用户行为未必忠实反映真实偏好，依赖信念的认知偏差可能让对齐系统陷入确认陷阱。论文将人机交互建模为多臂老虎机，比较被动观察与主动偏好探询的可识别性。理论证明，静态二元偏差用户与变换环境中的无偏用户可产生完全相同的行动轨迹分布，仅凭行动无法可靠区分；有限次对抗性零奖励干预则能使干预后的行动分布任意可分。这表明，稳健对齐不能只拟合行为，还需主动干预以区分偏好与偏差。
papers.abstract_en: Alignment methods typically treat user behavior as a reliable proxy for underlying preferences. However, this assumption breaks down when users hold belief-dependent cognitive biases, risking irreversible ``confirmation traps'' and harmful feedback loops. In this paper, we formalize when an AI system can distinguish true user preferences from behavior shaped by cognitive bias. Modeling this interaction as a multi-armed bandit, we first prove a non-identifiability theorem: under passive observation, a static binary biased user produces action trajectory distributions strictly identical to an unbiased user in a transformed environment, forcing any action-only estimator to perform no better than random guessing. We then show that active preference elicitation breaks this observational equivalence. Specifically, we prove that an Observer applying a finite sequence of adversarial zero-reward interventions of length $m_δ$ makes the post-intervention action distributions arbitrarily separable. Our theoretical results suggest that robust alignment requires actively intervening to tell informed preferences from biases.

papers.title_en: OpenMobile-2: Building Versatile Mobile Agents with Scalable Environments and App-Native Tools
papers.authors: Chenyang Yan, Yingying Zhang, Kanzhi Cheng, Qiushi Sun, Zhengyuan Pan, Zheng Ma, Hang Yan, Yian Wang, Nuo Chen, Jialin Cao, Xingdong Gong, Wenpo Song, Han Chen, Zichen Ding, Fangzhi Xu, Shujian Huang, Xinyu Dai, Yichen Liu, Tiankuo Yao, Bo Wang, Ben Kao, Jianbing Zhang, Lewei Lu, Dahua Lin
papers.evidence: 构建能够通过移动应用界面执行跨应用工作流的智能体
papers.tldr: 移动智能体训练受限于应用环境难以重置、任务奖励难以验证，以及真实应用交互复杂。OpenMobile-2构建覆盖110余款应用的开放环境，提供近1.2万条交互轨迹和2000余项可自动奖励的任务，并探索图形界面与应用原生工具混合调用。其在AndroidWorld和MobileWorld分别取得79.9和50.4分，SPA-Bench成绩由31.9升至59.6。工作开放环境与训练方案，为规模化训练及真实设备迁移提供基础。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce OpenMobile-2, a near-frontier mobile agent with fully open training environments and recipes. We make three key advances: (1) Diverse environments with simulated commercial apps: We build MobileGym++, featuring 35 realistic, functionally rich commercial-style apps with cross-app workflows, while preserving full controllability for reset and verification. Together with newly configured apps in Android emulators, this yields a diverse playground spanning over 110 apps. (2) Open training data at scale: Building on this foundation, we curate nearly 12K mobile interaction trajectories for supervised fine-tuning and the largest open collection of verifiable RL training data for mobile agents, comprising over 2K executable tasks with automatic rewards. (3) Hybrid GUI and app-native tool use: We explore an experimental mobile-use setting where apps expose selected functionalities as app-native tools alongside their GUIs, allowing agents to interleave GUI actions and tool calls within a task. We implement this setting in MobileGym++ with over 300 carefully scoped tools across 50+ apps. Additionally, we introduce MobileGym++ Bench for complex, long-horizon commercial mobile scenarios, supporting both GUI-only and hybrid GUI-tool evaluation on a shared task suite. OpenMobile-2 performs competitively across established benchmarks, including AndroidWorld (79.9) and MobileWorld (50.4), while showing promising transfer to real-device mobile use, nearly doubling SPA-Bench performance from 31.9 to 59.6. All resources are available at https://os-copilot.github.io/OpenMobile2-Home/.

papers.title_en: Decentralized Bandit Learning of Markov Perfect Equilibria
papers.authors: Felix Höfer, H. Mete Soner
papers.evidence: 研究多智能体马尔可夫博弈中的去中心化学习与均衡
papers.tldr: 在连续动作的一般和马尔可夫博弈中，智能体仅观察公共状态与自身实际奖励，如何分散学习动态均衡是核心问题。论文利用同时扰动随机逼近估计梯度，使智能体无需共享奖励即可更新动作。在负即时奖励梯度满足强单调性、时间步足够小的条件下，该过程几乎必然收敛到唯一的平稳马尔可夫完美均衡，收敛速率为O(n^{-1/2})。研究为有限反馈下的多智能体均衡学习提供理论保证，并扩展至回合式有限时域场景。
papers.abstract_en: We study decentralized bandit learning in discounted infinite-horizon, general-sum Markov games with continuous actions. Agents observe the public state, but only their own realized rewards, and use simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation to update their actions. Under strong monotonicity of the negative running-reward gradients and sufficiently small time steps, we prove that the fully decentralized procedure converges almost surely to the unique stationary Markov perfect equilibrium. We obtain an $O(n^{-1/2})$ convergence rate and present a natural extension to episodic finite-horizon learning.

papers.title_en: PEAM: On-device Communication Agent for Personalized, Efficient and Autonomous Mobile Network Configuration
papers.authors: Haowen Wan, Shangzhuo Xie, Syue-Ju Syue, Xianyue Wu, Runhua Li, Qianqian Yang
papers.evidence: 个性化端侧大模型智能体自主替用户配置移动网络。
papers.tldr: 移动网络配置需随应用和连接状态变化快速调整，但端侧大模型实时推理难以满足严格时延要求。PEAM将个性化决策拆为闲时规则生成与在线规则执行，通过真实用户数据微调、跨批次反思和用户画像提炼稳定规则。基于微调的4B模型，配置决策正确率达99.13%，生成规则有效率达92.50%。其核心价值是将模型推理移出实时路径，以毫秒级规则执行兼顾个性化、自主性与响应速度。
papers.abstract_en: The growing deployment of compact large language models on smartphones is enabling autonomous on-device decision-making, such as emerging mobile GUI agents. However, many mobile decisions, such as network configuration when users switch apps or connectivity conditions change, must satisfy stringent latency constraints to preserve user experience. In this paper, we propose PEAM, an on-device LLM-based communication agent that autonomously generates personalized network-configuration rules executable within milliseconds. Specifically, PEAM first fine-tune the on-device LLM with a dataset constructed from manually annotated real-user data to integrate the communication knowledge into the local model. PEAM then operates in two phases. In the rule-generation phase, which is performed when the device is idle, such as overnight, PEAM analyzes historical network-configuration records in batches and reflects across batches to consolidate consistent evidence, reduce local bias, and derive robust configuration rules. To enable more accurate and stable rule generation over time, PEAM further constructs a user profile from high-confidence rules to capture the user's network preferences and incorporates this profile into each rule-generation cycle. In the rule-execution phase, PEAM is invoked when the communication context changes, such as when users switch apps or connectivity conditions change, and searches the rule library to identify and execute the appropriate rule. Experiments demonstrate that PEAM, based on a fine-tuned 4B model, achieves 99.13% correct network configuration decisions, while 92.50% of the rules generated by PEAM are valid, outperforming the traditional expert-rule based method by 4.41% and 84.50%, respectively.

papers.title_en: PAT: A Personality-Driven Augmentation and Transfer Learning Framework for Depression Detection on Social Media
papers.authors: Shengwu Zheng, Yuzhe Ding, Xiaohui Liang, Fei Li, Chong Teng, Donghong Ji
papers.evidence: 利用人格信息辅助社交媒体抑郁识别
papers.tldr: 社交媒体抑郁检测常因表面词汇匹配误筛帖子，且仅靠用户级标签难以学习细粒度抑郁线索。PAT以人格理论驱动大语言模型生成增强数据，通过对比学习训练帖子级编码器，再将评分器用于筛帖，并迁移编码器支持用户级检测。摘要报告该方法显著优于现有方法，但未提供具体指标与提升幅度。框架还能追踪帖子级心理状态变化、突出关键症状，为检测结果提供多粒度解释，其临床可靠性仍需进一步验证。
papers.abstract_en: Depression is a prevalent mental disorder that affects millions worldwide, with early detection crucial for effective intervention. While exist?ing methods have achieved promising results in automated depression detection, they face two key limitations: (1) noise in post screening: symptom-based semantic screening is easily misled by superficial lexical patterns, thereby introducing false-positive posts; (2) weak op?timization of the post encoder: relying solely on coarse user-level supervision signals pre?vents models from capturing depressive cues within individual posts. To address these limita?tions, we propose PAT, a Personality-driven Augmentation and Transfer learning frame?work. In the first phase, PAT optimizes a post?level encoder via a fine-grained contrastive learning objective, utilizing LLM-based data augmentation driven by classic personality the?ories to alleviate data scarcity. In the second phase, the trained post-level scorer is deployed for high-quality post filtering, while its en?coder parameters are seamlessly transferred for user-level tasks. Extensive experiments demon?strate that PAT significantly outperforms exist?ing methods. Furthermore, PAT delivers multi?granular interpretability by tracing post-level mental-state trajectories and highlighting key symptoms, thereby offering reliable diagnostic evidence for clinical practice.

papers.title_en: Multi-Objective Aligned Small Language Model Framework for SUD Patient Dialogue Generation
papers.authors: Thushara Manjari Naduvilakandy, Hyeju Jang, Mohammad Al Hasan
papers.evidence: 面向物质使用障碍咨询与治疗场景生成临床一致的患者对话
papers.tldr: 物质使用障碍咨询中的患者模拟不仅需要语言流畅，还须体现信念、应对策略与改变意愿；通用模型常缺乏认知一致性，大模型部署也受成本与隐私约束。论文提出两阶段小语言模型框架，先检测认知成分，再结合患者历史和咨询师问题生成对齐回复，并融合知识蒸馏、人工偏好优化及注意力引导奖励塑形。自动指标与大模型评审显示，其认知表达和对齐优于通用及心理健康领域小模型，开放式认知成分提升尤为明显，为资源受限场景的患者模拟提供了路径。
papers.abstract_en: Substance Use Disorder (SUD) counseling requires patient responses that reflect underlying cognitive states such as beliefs, coping strategies, and readiness for change. Although large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent text, they often fail to produce cognitively coherent and clinically realistic patient behavior, especially under ethical and data-scarce clinical settings. Moreover, deploying frontier-scale LLMs in healthcare applications presents practical challenges including high computational cost, latency, privacy concerns, and limited deployability in resource-constrained environments, motivating the need for cognitively aligned small language models (SLMs). We propose a cognitively grounded framework for SUD patient dialogue generation that explicitly models and aligns latent cognitive components with patient histories and counselor questions. Our pipeline consists of two stages: cognitive component detection and cognitive component-aligned dialogue generation. To enable effective learning with smaller models, we combine knowledge distillation from high-capacity teacher models, preference optimization from human-annotations, and attention-guided reward shaping. Extensive evaluations using automatic scores like BERTScore, ROUGE, METEOR and BLEU, and LLM-as-judge hit-metrics against both human and teacher-model references show that cognitively informed fine-tuning substantially improves cognitive realization and alignment over a generic instruction-tuned baselines and mental health domain specific SLMs, with particularly strong gains for open-ended cognitive components.

papers.title_en: Love for Believable AI: Artificial Partiality and Relationship Persistence as an Engineerable Stance
papers.authors: Sebastian Cochinescu
papers.evidence: 为对话智能体设计持续且个性化的关系行为
papers.tldr: 对话智能体如何在保障所有用户基本服务的同时，表现出随关系积累而变化的差别关照？论文在同一开源权重模型上加入持久化层，以有限额外资源分配和用户状态估计实现人工偏爱。构造式多会话实验复现了预设差异曲线的顺序趋势，但未达到其幅度，修订机制的质量等价性也未跨测试集成立。研究提供了可供后续感知实验检验的机制原型，而非用户感受到爱、信任或依恋的证据。
papers.abstract_en: We study a behavioral mechanism for artificial partiality in conversational agents. The paper reports no human-subjects data and makes no claim about attachment, trust, perceived mind, or machine interiority. Partiality has two components: caring, defined as allocation of a finite interaction surplus above a guaranteed per-user service floor, and particularity, defined as a per-user state estimate accumulated from relationship history on fixed inference machinery. We implement both as a persistence layer over one open-weight base model and evaluate them on constructed multi-session relationships with known hidden-state schedules. A four-channel divergence compares known-user and stranger conditions on identical probes with paired generation seeds; the stranger prompt is not length-matched, and one channel (initiative) is an allocator output rather than generated behavior. The full mechanism reproduces the ordinal shape, but not the magnitude, of an analytically specified curve and is the only arm satisfying the protocol-defined joint signature on the calibrated battery. The initial mechanism fails probe-quality equivalence because relationship content reduces topical relevance. A guarded revision satisfies equivalence on the calibrated battery but not on a second battery not used in calibration, where it scores higher than the unmodified baseline. On that second battery, the specificity margin is 0.0198, below the 0.02 protocol threshold. The paired mean right-user--wrong-user estimation-accuracy contrast is 0.375 but is not positive in every run. The mechanism is therefore a candidate for a later perception study, not evidence that users perceive love. The versioned protocol record is not independently time-stamped and is not described as a preregistration. Ethical constraints include a stranger-treatment floor, a bounded surplus, disclosure, and de-intensification.

papers.title_en: RewardWeaver: Long-Horizon Interactive Learning for Language Agents via Self-Evolving Reward Adaptation
papers.authors: Hengbo Xiao, Boyao Zhang, Purui Liu, Yuxuan Zheng, Haoran Yin, Haibo Liu, Fan Zhang
papers.evidence: 为语言智能体的长期交互学习调整过程奖励
papers.tldr: 长程交互中，语言智能体面临终局奖励稀疏、行为归因困难的问题，固定过程奖励也难以匹配训练中变化的能力瓶颈。RewardWeaver保持已验证能力评分准则的语义稳定，逐阶段从低结果轨迹反向归因，识别反复出现且策略可控的瓶颈，再动态选择下一阶段的过程奖励。在社交互动、双边议价和领域销售三类任务上，论文报告均达到最先进水平。其贡献是将策略训练、失败诊断与奖励调整闭环衔接，而非持续改写评分标准。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has driven substantial progress in domains where task outcomes can be reliably evaluated, but long-horizon interaction remains challenging due to sparse terminal feedback and difficult credit assignment. Process rewards provide denser supervision, yet the capabilities most relevant for training can change as the policy evolves: a behavior that is easy to evaluate or frequently deficient need not be the bottleneck currently limiting task success. We introduce RewardWeaver, a self-evolving reward adaptation framework for language agents in long-horizon interaction. RewardWeaver maintains a validated capability space in which the semantics of admitted Rubrics remain fixed, and closes the loop between policy optimization, task evaluation, failure attribution, and reward adaptation. After each training stage, it performs outcome-grounded backward attribution on low-outcome trajectories, aggregates recurrent and policy-controlled capability bottlenecks, and dynamically selects the corresponding process rewards for the next stage. Recurrent failures not covered by the existing capability space trigger a separate, controlled expansion procedure. We evaluate REWARDWEAVER on SOTOPIA, Amazon?HistoryPrice, and a newly constructed Sales Benchmark. Across social interaction, bilateral bargaining, and domain-specific sales, REWARDWEAVER establishes new state-of-the-art (SOTA) results. Ablations further demonstrate the importance of dynamic reward allocation, failure-grounded attribution, and stable semantics for admitted capabilities.

papers.title_en: Agentic RSR: Real-to-Sim-to-Real through Scene Reconstruction and Execution-Grounded Robot Policies
papers.authors: Yihan Li, Yating Feng, Shengjiu Sun, Jianing Chen, Hao Ren, Bowen Yang, Weisheng Xu, Qiwei Wu, Hui Cheng, Renjing Xu
papers.evidence: 智能体利用视觉反馈迭代重建场景并开发可执行机器人策略。
papers.tldr: 机器人仿真既需保留任务相关交互，也需让策略适应真实传感观测，但场景重建与策略开发常被割裂。该框架从工作区视频、任务描述和机器人模型出发，以智能体迭代重建场景、验证物理交互，并通过执行反馈开发可迁移策略。在两种机器人的18个重建场景中，平均深度误差为0.1057米，实机任务成功率达到仿真成功率的80%。其贡献是以共享任务接口串联重建、策略开发与实机执行，形成任务驱动的迁移闭环。
papers.abstract_en: A simulation of a real robot workspace must preserve task-relevant interactions, while policies developed in it must operate on observations available to the real robot. Yet scene reconstruction and policy development are often treated separately. We present Agentic Real-to-Sim-to-Real (Agentic RSR), a framework that links scene reconstruction, policy development, and real-robot execution through the same manipulation task. Given a workspace video, a task description, and a known robot model, an agent recovers metric scale, iteratively refines the scene using visual feedback, and checks task-relevant interactions in MuJoCo. A coding agent then develops an executable policy, progressing from privileged object poses to visual observations and randomized simulation. The policy can interleave multiple observations and actions within one invocation, while the agent uses execution feedback to continue, retry, or revise its approach. A shared task-level interface carries the policy and accumulated experience to the real robot, where fresh observations and safety checks guide execution. Across 18 reconstructed scenes involving two robots, the mean four-view Depth MAE against reference depth estimates is 0.1057 m, the mean Lab $ΔE_{76}$ is 11.04, and the mean grayscale SSIM is 0.6990. In real-robot experiments, the aggregate task success rate reaches 80% of the simulation task success rate, indicating substantial retention of simulated performance on hardware. Code and reconstructed scene data will be made publicly available.

papers.title_en: Cognition-Oriented Emotion Tracing from Causes to Consequences in Real-World Social Scenes
papers.authors: Hao Li, Jinye Zhang, Bobo Li, Mong-Li Lee, Wynne Hsu, Zheng Wang, Hao Fei, Min Zhang
papers.evidence: 利用多模态线索分析现实社交场景中的情绪过程与调节
papers.tldr: 现有情感计算多依赖表层线索，难以解释情绪如何受认知评价、表达调节与社会互动影响。论文提出TRACE，以条件、情感和后果刻画情绪过程，并构建覆盖646段视频、3746组问答的五任务基准。进一步提出TRACER，让推理显式引用观察、认知评价及上游结论，形成可追溯推理图。该方法在五项任务上均优于所有受测模型基线，为从情绪识别走向有据可查的全过程理解提供路径。
papers.abstract_en: Affective computing has progressed from categorical emotion recognition to open-ended affective analysis with large multimodal models. Yet affective science describes emotion as an unfolding process shaped by appraisal, regulation, and social interpretation, which remains underexplored computationally. We propose TRACE, a cognition-oriented framework that formalizes an affective episode through three interrelated stages: Condition, Affect, and Effect, integrating observable cues with cognitive factors such as internal stance and regulation of emotional display. Based on this formulation, TRACE-Bench evaluates multimodal models in real-world social scenes through five tasks spanning grounded affect recognition, regulation decoding, cause reasoning, effect reasoning, and full-chain reconstruction, with 3,746 structured question-answer pairs over 646 videos. A matched human-model comparison reveals a substantial performance gap, while affect-specialized models also generally lag behind general-purpose MLLMs. Model outputs show recurring failures, including treating displayed behavior as genuine feeling and fabricating unsupported events during long-chain generation. We further propose TRACER, a cognition-grounded structured reasoning method that couples each inference with explicit premises from factual observations, cognitive appraisals, and established upstream conclusions, forming a traceable graph of intermediate and target conclusions. TRACER outperforms all evaluated model baselines on each of the five tasks. Project page: https://cogaffc.github.io/TRACE

papers.title_en: Multi-Agent Egocentric World Model with Fine-Grained Embodied Interaction
papers.authors: Dahyun Chung, Siyoon Jin, Hyunwook Choi, Honggyu An, Junyoung Seo, Hyunsung Kim, Seung Wook Kim, Seungryong Kim
papers.evidence: 研究建模多个智能体在共享世界中的细粒度交互。
papers.tldr: 现有第一人称世界模型多面向单智能体，多智能体方法也主要使用移动等粗粒度动作，难以刻画精细交互。ME-World在共享词元序列中联合去噪多路第一人称视频，以所有智能体的目标视角姿态作为条件，并引入共享环境记忆。真实与合成数据实验表明，该方法提升了共享世界一致性、动作控制、身份保持和视频质量。研究还提出环境、状态更新与身份一致性指标，为多智能体精细具身交互的建模与评估提供框架。
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric world models predict first-person observations conditioned on an agent's actions, but most focus on a single agent. Real embodied settings often involve multiple agents that act and interact within a shared environment. Existing multi-agent world models rely on coarse actions like locomotion, camera control, or discrete commands, leaving fine-grained embodied interactions underexplored. We formulate multi-agent egocentric world modeling as synchronized ego-stream generation for multiple agents interacting through fine-grained actions in a shared world. This requires cross-view action consistency, shared-environment consistency, and consistent propagation of interaction-induced state updates. We propose Multi-agent Egocentric World Model (ME-World), which jointly denoises multiple ego streams in a shared token sequence, conditions each stream on all agents' target-view poses, and grounds generation with shared environment memory. We train and evaluate on real and synthetic multi-agent data and introduce shared-world consistency metrics for environment, update, and identity consistency. Experiments show ME-World improves shared-world consistency, action control, identity preservation, and video quality over existing methods.
